children: of its Delta, British Columbia manufacturing facility, aiming to boost total production capacity by 15%.

"Driven by a growing consumer preference for 100% chemical-free decaffeination over traditional solvent-based methods, the company is scaling up operations to accommodate high utilization rates and capture new market share
said Frank Dennis, Swiss Water’s President & CEO.
Construction on the technologically advanced production line is set to begin in Q1 2027 with no disruption to existing operations.
The project is slated for completion in June 2027, with the expanded output fully operational by July 2027.
Swiss Water expects to fund the majority of the $6.2M outlay internally through cash flow generated from operations, utilizing existing credit facilities to cover the remaining balance.

title: Swiss Water to expand Delta facility with $6.2M investment to meet chemical-free demand
